statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because NQ is closed and no persistent one-way price path can be observed; Stress is extreme amid renewed Saudi security risk, oil-supply disruption and constrained Hormuz traffic.
recommendation: Deterministic mapping is EA_ON because Tail remains below the WATCH threshold; weekend geopolitical and energy uncertainty is represented primarily in Stress rather than inferred price-path failure.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress as Saudi security risk adds to the closed-weekend gap backdrop
body: NQ futures are closed, so no current shallow-pullback, failed-retracement or repeated-extension pattern can be verified. Reuters reported smoke near Riyadh's main airport after overnight alerts and an all-clear, while Saudi oil logistics and Hormuz traffic remain disrupted. Friday's Nasdaq gain was semiconductor-led but breadth was negative. Shared Finviz context from 09:45:53Z is older than 90 minutes and was not used as current supporting evidence.
